value_stream.name: In-Store Value-Added Services & Financial Agency Operations

Automation Opportunity: - Principal-statement reconciliation; float/settlement automation; commission-revenue booking
Controls: - CTL-93 (ensure VAS agency cash & BSP compliance.)
- CTL-700: transactions reconciled to principal; float monitored/timely-settled (VS-18); commission tax-treated (VS-79); SoD
Cross-references: - links to VS-17/VS-18 (finance/treasury), VS-81 (CIT), VS-79 (tax), VS-72 (intercompany), W4602–W4604 (principals), W4613 (cash reconciliation)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Settlement-mismatch risk**: BuildRight cash ≠ principal statement → dispute/loss; mitigated by reconciliation & SoD
- **Float-risk**: BuildRight carries float between collection and principal settlement; mitigated by timely settlement & float monitoring
System Touchpoints: - Finance/GL (VS-17); treasury/float (VS-18); CIT/banking (VS-81); tax (VS-79); intercompany (VS-72); principals (W4602–W4604)

steps.activity: Finance/Principals reconcile VAS transactions to principal statements (bills/remittance/e-money/load), and settle collected cash vs principal (net commission) per cycle
Treasury/Finance manage the float/settlement account (VS-18), ensure cash is banked/settled timely (VS-81), and monitor float aging
Finance/Tax book commission revenue (VS-79 VAT/withholding), manage intercompany where applicable (VS-72), and report settlement/commission to the board (VS-36)

workflows.name: VAS General Ledger, Revenue Recognition & Intercompany

Automation Opportunity: - GL/commission automation; revenue-recognition rules; intercompany allocation (VS-72)
Controls: - CTL-700 (ensure controlled execution — Settlement, Reconciliation, Compliance (AML/BSP) & Analytics (PA-156.3).)
- CTL-700: VAS GL distinct/accurate (VS-17); revenue recognized per policy (VS-79); intercompany settled (VS-72); audited (VS-21)
Cross-references: - links to VS-17 (finance), VS-79 (tax), VS-18 (treasury), VS-72 (intercompany), VS-21 (audit), W4617 (settlement)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Revenue-timing-error risk**: Commission recognized at wrong time → audit issue; mitigated by clear recognition policy
- **Intercompany-error risk**: VAS across entities mis-allocated; mitigated by intercompany discipline (VS-72)

steps.activity: Finance account VAS activity in the GL (commission revenue, float, transaction fees, refunds) per VS-17, with distinct cost-center per VAS line
Finance/Tax recognize revenue correctly (commission at settlement/earning, not at transaction; VAT/withholding VS-79), and manage intercompany across 5 entities (VS-72)
Finance/Audit ensure GL accuracy, reconcile to principals/cash (W4617/W4613), and report VAS P&L to commercial/board (VS-36)

fields.Participants: Counter Staff, Principals (W4603), Legal (VS-100.3), Audit (VS-21), AMLC
fields.Trigger: AML threshold; suspicious pattern; sanctions check

Automation Opportunity: - Suspicious-pattern/sanctions screening; STR-workflow automation; AML-record management
Controls: - CTL-93 (ensure VAS agency cash & BSP compliance.)
- CTL-700: AML/KYC monitored as agent (VS-86); sanctions screened; STRs filed to AMLC; agent compliance documented
Cross-references: - links to VS-86 (AML), VS-22 (compliance), VS-28 (data), VS-100.3 (legal), VS-21 (audit), W4603 (principal), W4610/W4611/W4614 (transactions/KYC)
Pain Points / Risks: - **AML-failure risk**: Missed suspicious activity/sanctions match → BuildRight/principal regulatory exposure (VS-86); mitigated by monitoring, screening & STR filing
- **Agent-vs-principal-ambiguity risk**: Unclear AML responsibility; mitigated by documented agent-of-principal program
System Touchpoints: - AML (VS-86); compliance (VS-22); data/analytics (VS-28); legal (VS-100.3); audit (VS-21); principal AML (W4603)

steps.activity: AML/Compliance monitor VAS transactions for suspicious patterns (structuring/smurfing, rapid cash-in/out, high-risk geographies) as agent, per VS-86 and principal program
AML/Compliance screen for sanctions/watchlist (customer name/ID), and file suspicious-transaction reports (STR) to AMLC per the principal's BSP program (VS-86)
Audit/Legal ensure AML/KYC agent compliance (records, training, reporting), coordinate with principals, and report AML posture to the board (VS-36)

fields.Trigger: Regulatory cycle; threshold transaction; BSP request

Automation Opportunity: - Regulatory/CTR-report automation; principal data-feed; BSP-exam evidence pack
Controls: - CTL-93 (ensure VAS agency cash & BSP compliance.)
- CTL-700: BSP/CTR reporting accurate & timely (VS-22); agent data fed to principals; records retained (VS-88); exam-ready (VS-21)
Cross-references: - links to VS-22 (compliance), VS-79 (tax), VS-86/W4619 (AML/CTR), VS-88 (records), VS-100.3 (legal), VS-21 (audit), W4619 (AML)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Reporting-error risk**: Inaccurate/late BSP/CTR reporting → penalty; mitigated by controls & calendar
- **Records-gap risk**: Missing transaction records → audit/exam failure; mitigated by retention (VS-88)
System Touchpoints: - Compliance/BSP (VS-22); tax (VS-79); AML/CTR (VS-86/W4619); records (VS-88); legal (VS-100.3); audit (VS-21)

steps.activity: Compliance/Finance prepare VAS regulatory reporting (BSP agent reporting per principal program, cash-transaction/CTR thresholds, commission/tax VS-79), per VS-22
Compliance/Principals coordinate reporting (BuildRight agent data feeds to principals for their BSP reporting), and manage BSP inquiries/examinations
Audit/Compliance ensure reporting accuracy/completeness, retain records (VS-88), and report compliance posture to the board (VS-36)

Automation Opportunity: - Fraud-pattern detection/ML (VS-125); case management; loss-exposure analytics
Controls: - CTL-700 (ensure controlled execution — Settlement, Reconciliation, Compliance (AML/BSP) & Analytics (PA-156.3).)
- CTL-700: VAS fraud vectors controlled (VS-125/VS-23); cash SoD (W4613); liability/insurance in place (VS-26); losses investigated/recovered
Cross-references: - links to VS-125 (fraud), VS-21.2 (risk), VS-23 (LP), VS-26 (insurance), W4606 (liability), W4613 (cash), W4615 (reversal-fraud)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Account-takeover/reversal-fraud risk**: Financial loss + customer harm (VS-125); mitigated by verification, SoD, monitoring
- **Internal-theft risk**: VAS cash skim (VS-23/VS-142); mitigated by cash controls & SoD (W4613)
System Touchpoints: - Fraud (VS-125); risk/ERM (VS-21.2); LP (VS-23); compliance (VS-22); cash mgmt (VS-08.2); insurance (VS-26); audit (VS-21)

steps.a: Head of Fraud / Head of Internal Audit & Risk
steps.activity: Fraud/Risk identify VAS fraud vectors (account-takeover cash-out, reversal-fraud, load/chargeback fraud, internal cash theft VS-23, structuring VS-86) and design controls
Fraud/LP monitor for fraud patterns, investigate incidents, recover losses, and coordinate with principals/law enforcement (VS-125/VS-23)

steps.a: Head of Internal Audit & Risk / CFO
steps.activity: Risk/Finance quantify VAS loss exposure, manage liability/insurance (VS-26/W4606), and report fraud/loss to the board (VS-36)

Automation Opportunity: - Footfall/basket-linkage model; cost-to-serve analytics; portfolio dashboards
Controls: - CTL-700 (ensure controlled execution — Settlement, Reconciliation, Compliance (AML/BSP) & Analytics (PA-156.3).)
- CTL-700: performance measured vs baseline (W4601); cost-to-serve tracked; basket-linkage validated; board-reported (VS-36)
Cross-references: - links to VS-28 (data), VS-44 (insights), VS-13 (loyalty), VS-07 (stores), VS-17.4 (finance), W4601 (baseline), W4617 (commission)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Attribution-error risk**: Mis-credited footfall/basket to VAS; mitigated by controlled baseline comparison
- **Cost-to-serve-blindness risk**: VAS unprofitable per store unseen; mitigated by cost-to-serve analytics
System Touchpoints: - Data/BI (VS-28); insights (VS-44); loyalty/CRM (VS-13); store ops (VS-07); finance (VS-17.4); marketing (VS-14)

steps.activity: Data/Commercial measure VAS performance (transaction volume, commission revenue, cost-to-serve, footfall lift, basket-linkage to retail) vs baseline (W4601)
Data/Insights analyze basket-linkage (VAS customers who also buy retail, incremental basket), footfall-by-store/region, and channel mix
Commercial/Finance report portfolio intelligence to the board (VS-36), tune portfolio/stores (W4601), and inform strategy (VS-33)

Automation Opportunity: - Control-testing automation; finding/remediation tracking; assurance dashboards
Controls: - CTL-700 (ensure controlled execution — Settlement, Reconciliation, Compliance (AML/BSP) & Analytics (PA-156.3).)
- CTL-700: VAS control framework defined & tested (VS-21); findings remediated; principal audits coordinated; board-reported (VS-36)
Cross-references: - links to VS-21 (audit), VS-22 (compliance), VS-21.2 (risk), VS-125 (fraud), W4613/W4617/W4619/W4621 (controls)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Control-gap risk**: Undetected cash/AML/settlement weakness; mitigated by periodic audit & testing
- **Finding-backlog risk**: Unremediated findings; mitigated by tracking & board oversight
System Touchpoints: - Audit (VS-21); compliance (VS-22); risk (VS-21.2); fraud (VS-125); finance (VS-17); principals (W4602–W4604)

steps.activity: Audit/Compliance define the VAS control framework (cash SoD W4613, KYC/AML W4619, settlement W4617, disclosure W4616, fraud W4621), per VS-21/VS-22
Audit test controls (cash counts, transaction sampling, KYC/AML records, settlement reconciliation), and report findings
Compliance/Finance remediate findings, coordinate with principal audits, and report assurance to the board (VS-36)

workflows.name: VAS Program Performance Review & Strategic Adjustment

Automation Opportunity: - Performance-vs-baseline dashboards; strategic-options modeling; risk-adjusted-return analytics
Controls: - CTL-700 (ensure controlled execution — Settlement, Reconciliation, Compliance (AML/BSP) & Analytics (PA-156.3).)
- CTL-700: program reviewed vs success metrics (W4601); adjustments legal-validated (agency-only VS-100.3); board-reported (VS-36)
Cross-references: - links to VS-33 (strategy), VS-22/VS-100.3 (compliance/legal), VS-21.2 (risk), VS-134 (OCM), W4601 (baseline), W4622 (analytics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Sunk-cost bias**: Persisting with underperforming/unprofitable-per-store VAS; mitigated by success-metric review
- **Charter-creep risk**: Adjusting toward principal activity (lending/remitting); mitigated by legal validation on structural change (W4601/VS-100.3)
System Touchpoints: - Strategy (VS-33); compliance/legal (VS-22/VS-100.3); risk (VS-21.2); store ops (VS-07); OCM (VS-134); board (VS-36)

steps.activity: COO/CFO/Strategy review the VAS program vs W4601 success metrics (footfall, basket-linkage, commission revenue, risk-adjusted return), and the strategic rationale
COO/Strategy/Legal evaluate strategic adjustments (expand/restructure portfolio, change partners, adjust store coverage, exit) if performance/rationale changes
COO/Commercial execute the chosen path (adjust portfolio/partners/stores W4601/W4602–W4604), with OCM (VS-134), and report to the board (VS-36)
